scope: Q7 direct IPU task queue and software completion path for fresh HDR; static code plus bounded replay.

evidence.observation: CIpuDriver constructor creates a one-word message queue at driver+0x224, starts ThrIpuDriver, registers done ISR number 0x29 and strip ISR number 0xcf, and creates the driver event group at +0x30c. These are software registration IDs, not a proved physical interrupt source.

CIpuTask::Go tail-calls AddTask with driver=task+0x1c8. AddTask sends one task pointer to driver+0x224 with wait 0; any nonzero API return enters OsSysHaltEx. RunTask saves the previous/current task at +0x90/+0x8c, calls task vtable+0x2c (CIpuTaskC12::WriteAll), clears the strip counter through RunPreActivation, then emits 1 to 0xb60001cc, reads 0xb0802024, and emits 0 to 0xb6000000. No hardware meaning is assigned to the intervening read.

ThrIpuDriver receives with wait 0xffffffff, clears event bit0 using flags=0xfffffffe/option2, runs the task under a mutex, then waits for bit0 with option1 and 5000 ticks. Success calls PowerOff and CObservable::Notify(driver,2,current_task). Nonzero wait status prints a diagnostic and calls OsSysHaltEx; it is not a normal completion callback. Milliseconds are not inferred from the tick count.

SetTasksParams stores start/end at driver+0x344/+0x348 and resets IRQ counter +0x34c. IsrIpuDone signals global event 0x815ccc74 mask0x40000000 only when end>=2 and old IRQ counter==end-2; it always increments the counter and sets bit0 of driver+0x30c. Thus the global early event is not the final PathWait event. StripDone separately notifies event1 to the current task observer.

C12 WriteAll registers task+8 as driver observer at 0x803574e0. Its vtable points to the -8 this-adjustment thunk and CIpuTaskC12::Update. OnProcessingDone notifies event2 through the task observer (processor+8), whose thunk dispatches CImageProcessor::Update. CObservable carries one observer pointer at +4; it does not broadcast to a task list.

C12 Update(event2) increments task+0x220 and compares it with subimage count +0x224 in mode task+0x228==0. If more remain, CommitSubImage and AddTask requeue the same task, then Notify(event4). Otherwise it resets +0x220 and calls OnProcessingDone(event2). Modes1 and2 take distinct finalization branches. A hardware done IRQ therefore need not be a whole-task or whole-HDR completion.

For mode0/CBC0, processor Update(event2) increments completed-pass count +0x304. With N=4 and all four task slots nonnull, first three pass completions do not signal final path bit0. Count2 calls SetNrPhase(2), producing callback mask0x20 and path event0x04000000. Count4 reaches final completion accounting at +0x2f4; when it equals target +0x2f0, temporary resources are released and phase3 is set before event2 notification. Missing DC-task and other mode branches remain separate.

Fresh path setup passes IpuCallBack to IpuSetCallBack. The allocated CObserverWrapper stores the function pointer at +4 and dispatches the event mask as callback argument0. IpuCallBack event2 sets 0x815a1bc4 bit0, while event0x20 sets mask0x04000000. ConvertPathInit gives type0 registry wait-mask1. PathWait reads that mask and waits with option1 using path+0xac (fresh default40000 ticks). IpuToneMapRgb calls PathWait after PathGo and returns success only after that branch succeeds; no actual wait or IRQ timing was observed.

trace_limitations: Extents end at the next distinct sidecar address, not a typed ELF function size.
Linear MIPS32 word scan; edges are instruction candidates, not proof of reachability.
Delay slots are included in extents. Register-indirect targets are unresolved.
A jump is recorded as a transfer, not automatically a function call.

replay.scope: Original queue wrapper, IRQ handler, one driver iteration and observer chain; synthetic objects and injected API outcomes, no camera or RTOS scheduling.

modeled_functions.0x80357098: WriteAll records invocation; device/filter programming omitted

limitations: IRQ calls and event-get results are injected, not hardware observations.
Callback cases use four non-null task slots, one subimage per task, mode 0 and CBC 0.
Geometry, WriteAll, cleanup, IRQ acknowledge and physical pixel results are outside this replay.

external_reference.purpose: Modern official ThreadX constant names: option0 OR, option1 OR_CLEAR, option2 AND, wait0 NO_WAIT, 0xffffffff WAIT_FOREVER. Used as naming cross-reference, not proof of Q7 RTOS version.

limitations: Original IRQ source, electrical events and ISR dispatch were not executed. ISR wrappers are statically registered; injected invocations test software behavior only.
Task count and IRQ count are different when subimages are requeued. No per-pixel processing, cache coherence, DMA completion or image validity is proved.
Callback replay uses synthetic geometry/result values and mocks cleanup/WriteAll/RTOS operations; exact modeled boundaries are listed in replay.
